bool-sequence.expect: a card-record line of the signing record is malformed (sequence an integer, digest 64 hex)

foreign-key.expect: a card-record line names another root than the pinned one

gap.expect: the signing record's card-record lines are not 1..1 without a gap

marker-other-root.expect: regalia-signing-state.json names another root than the pinned one

not-an-object.expect: line 2 of the signing record is not an object with a kind

rebuild-record-missing.expect: the signing record has a baseline but
